case_title: Sham@ Kishor Bhaskarrao Matkari v. State of Maharashtra
aggravating_circumstances: Victims were defenceless, assault on children, premeditated attack, false story by accused, no third person involved, brutal nature of injuries, accused slept with victims
mitigating_circumstances: No pre-plan or premeditation, unblemished antecedents, no weapon used, not a rarest of rare case
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.302 and s.307 IPC, sentenced to life imprisonment and 7 years
high_court_outcome: Confirmed conviction, enhanced sentence to death
neutral_facts: The accused and his brother resided together in a rented house. A dispute over property led to a quarrel between the accused and his brother. The accused, after a confrontation, returned to the house during the night and assaulted his brother, his brother's wife, and their children. The victims were found dead or injured in the house, with signs of burns and head injuries. The accused was found with bloodstains on his hands and clothes. The police arrived and took the accused to the hospital. The accused made a statement to the Executive Magistrate admitting to the killings. Medical experts confirmed the cause of death and injuries. The trial court convicted the accused for murder and attempted murder, sentencing him to life imprisonment and seven years. The High Court upheld the conviction but enhanced the sentence to death.
